question: Where do beings go and from where do they return?
premises: All beings go to the Lord's nature.
At dissolution they enter that nature.
At creation the Lord emits them again.
inference: Nature is the unmanifest source and resting place of beings.
uncertainties: The fused token is kept whole.
plain_english: All beings, son of Kunti, go to my nature at world-dissolution; again at world-beginning I emit those beings into unmanifest nature.
